title: Minimum Rental Standards by State: A Landlord Checklist
description: Minimum rental standards by state: smoke alarms, heating, locks, mould and ventilation rules for NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT and NT landlords.
takeaways: Each state sets its own rental minimum standards
Photoelectric smoke alarms are required in every jurisdiction
Keep a compliance folder for every property
